items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think Sonny Stitt would have blended in very musically

ctx.x: Through the Claude Thornhill thing. Miles was friends with Gerry and Gil. [He] came to hear the band. That was basically Gerry and Gil’s band, that’s pretty clear. I think Miles approved of their suggestions, obviously.
Although as you mentioned, they were originally talking about having Sonny Stitt play alto. How did that end up in your favor as opposed to getting Stitt?
I don’t know what happened exactly but I think Gerry talked him out of that in terms of the balance that my sound would add to the ensemble. This was a chamber group.
